verses.1: Upon the rivers of Babylon, there we shall sit and remember Zion.
verses.2: On the rocks within it, we hung our water containers.
verses.3: For there, our songs are once again words of joy; our praises are songs that bring us happiness from the singing of Zion.
verses.4: How shall we sing the LORD’s song on the land of Nebuchadnezzar?
verses.5: If I forget about Jerusalem, then my right hand will also forget.
verses.6: I will wait for the right time. If you don’t remember me, or if I don’t take Jerusalem back from those who are against it, then I won’t do anything.
verses.7: Remember the day when Jehovah remembered the children of Adam. It was the day of Jerusalem, when people cried out in joy until the end.
verses.8: The daughter of Babylon, the murderer, you shall be punished for the shameful things you have done. You have made us shameful.
verses.9: May he hold it and break your idols into pieces.
